children: Vir Biotechnology reported that its Phase 3 ECLIPSE 1 trial met its primary endpoint: 44% achieved undetectable HDV RNA plus normalized ALT at Week 48, versus 0% in the delayed-treatment group at Week 12 (p<0.0001).
The combination met the pivotal trial's primary endpoint; the comparator was delayed treatment assessed at Week 12.
The key secondary endpoint was met, showing viral suppression; the delayed-treatment group had 0% at Week 12.
The release reports one Grade 3 event, which resolved in 15 days, with no treatment interruptions or discontinuations.
ECLIPSE 2 and 3 data expected in Q1 2027
Further pivotal-trial data are expected before the planned regulatory filing.
U.S. FDA submission planned for mid-2027
The filing timeline depends on data from all three trials and remains a company plan.

This is a pivotal Phase 3 readout for Vir's investigational chronic hepatitis delta regimen, following earlier development and regulatory designations. The next catalysts are ECLIPSE 2 and 3 data expected in Q1 2027 and the planned U.S. FDA submission in mid-2027.
